_comment: Widget registry — the single source of truth for addressable widgets (design/widget-system.md, 'First-Class Widgets'). Read by JS hosts (fetch) and Rust (include_str!). System trust tier ONLY: every page here ships in the app bundle; content-tier widgets (artifacts) never appear in this file and open via open_artifact_widget instead. `kind` is the name users, the hub launcher, and the agent all use; `description` is written for the agent directory (Phase 3).

widgets.title: Luna
widgets.description: The Luna conversation — chat with Luna, attachments, voice, artifacts and workflows

widgets.title: Settings
widgets.description: The settings launcher — lists every settings panel

widgets.title: Updates
widgets.description: Check for Luna Moon app updates and install them

widgets.title: General
widgets.description: General preferences: always on top, close on click away, the global shortcut, fresh thread

widgets.title: Connection

widgets.title: Voice
widgets.description: Voice settings: voice mode (off, push-to-talk, hands-free), spoken replies, TTS voice, silence timing, speech model

widgets.title: Vault
widgets.description: Secrets vault: stored credentials, add API keys and 1Password service-account tokens, 1Password sync

widgets.title: Skills
widgets.description: Enable, disable and search the agent skills the server offers

widgets.description: Connect external services (Google Workspace and others): add accounts, authorize, manage instances
